items.mainDefect: The OAuth2GrantType constructor calls formParams.getFirst() with no null check, so a null formParams throws an NPE.

secondary.defect: setFormParams() updates formParams but not the cached grantType, so getGrantType() returns a stale value and the wrong grant shortcut is encoded into the token ID.

items.mainDefect: isAccessTokenId in AssertEvents reads the grant shortcut from the wrong substring (3,5 instead of 4,6) and its condition is inverted, so wrong-grant encodings are not caught.

secondary.defect: The matcher does not check that the context prefix is exactly 6 characters long and does not use a split limit, so malformed IDs can cause errors.

items.mainDefect: The AssertEvents matcher disagrees with the encoder: it reads the grant shortcut at the wrong offset and its match condition is inverted.

secondary.defect: There is no length guard before calling substring, so a short prefix can throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException.

items.mainDefect: TokenManager does not guard against a null token context encoder provider when building the token ID.

secondary.defect: IllegalStateException and IllegalArgumentException thrown during encoding are not handled, so token creation crashes for unknown custom grants or unexpected session types instead of falling back to a raw UUID.

items.mainDefect: The OAuth2GrantType copy-constructor was removed or no longer copies grantType.

secondary.defect: setFormParams() does not update the cached grantType, so callers that change formParams generate tokens with the wrong grant shortcut.
